scope: Further optimization of vertex mapping / recursive parent-grid interpolation and deformer state preparation, preserving exact rendered output.

selection.criterion: Keep the additional mutable-view cache only if its matched-window mean and median both improve at least 1 percent over rest-only, and it wins at least 16 of 24 matched windows. Otherwise retain the simpler rest-only version.

outcome.summary: Immutable rest/keyform channels and independent unchanged grid-binding inputs are reused. Unsuccessful native mapping experiments were rolled back. Whole Worker and displayed model frame rates are reported separately, including non-improving intermediate results.

changes.description: Prepare immutable rest/keyform bone channels, winding corrections, rotation origins, scale/reflection and curve-handle coordinates once per node/binding identity. WeakMaps retain no frame history. Numeric interpolation and pose/channel round trips retain their original order.

Consume prepared channels, reuse immutable spatial defaults, and omit coordinate sampling only when the curve channel has zero coordinates. Nonempty numeric stages and existing origin-coordinate ordering remain unchanged.
Skip an individual binding only when all its axis and influence inputs remain Object.is-equal. Preserve other binding updates and their original accumulation order.

stageDiagnostics.method: Temporary source copies only; nested Date.now total/self timers; 240 warmup frames, three samples of 360 completed frames. Instrumentation adds per-call overhead and these stage durations are not release throughput or causal proof of a native mapping improvement. The former 3.32/1.68 ms measurements used different instrumentation/load conditions and must not be directly subtracted from these results.

quality.note: Old/new built artifacts, SSAA/MSAA, general scene fallback and main/Worker reference comparisons include document replacement, input bursts, resize, buffering changes and renderer recreation.

memory.limitations: GC heap/backing storage and logical resources measured; GPU driver VRAM/RSS and an hours-long physical soak were not measured.

validation.fixtureCorrection: The new test fixture was missing its required controlPoints field; it was corrected, all six tests in that file were rerun, and Puppet typecheck passed. Production code did not change after the full 2,851-test run.
validation.wallaby: MCP unavailable and installed global CLI entrypoint missing; repository Vitest runner used.

review.behavior: No remaining P0/P1/P2 finding identified in the changed cache/input/view paths after verification. No absence-of-defects claim outside this scope.
review.refactoring: Immutable channel preparation is owned by one cohesive module; I/O and diagnostics remain outside production.
review.structure: Changed production files remain below 600 lines. No new dependency, package script, timer or test-only production hook.
limitations: No additional native interpolation acceleration was verified.
A stable universal FPS uplift is not established by these runs.
Physical low-end hardware and other browsers were not benchmarked.
